FIELDS.NAME: Eagle Eye Security Services
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Senior Inspector, Eagle Eye Security Services, 123 Main Street, Suite 200, Springfield, IL 62701-1234, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@eagleeye.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Eagle Eye Security Services specializes in providing unarmed security guard services for commercial office buildings and residential communities. Our operations focus on ensuring the safety and security of our clients' properties through diligent monitoring, access control, and risk management strategies. We also offer private investigation services, including background checks and surveillance, tailored primarily for corporate clients. All our security personnel are licensed and compliant with local regulations, emphasizing our commitment to regulatory standards and minimizing legal risks. We utilize advanced technology for security system installations and monitoring, ensuring a proactive approach to preventing theft and enhancing safety. Our goal is to maintain a secure environment while delivering reliable and professional service without engaging in high-risk operations.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Private investigation services providing background checks for corporate clients.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2022, a theft occurred at our client’s commercial office building, resulting in a loss of $1,500. The incident was reported to the authorities, and security measures were enhanced following the event. The status of the loss is closed as the amount was covered by our comprehensive security insurance. Another incident on 07/10/2023 involved a minor damage claim of $3,000 due to vandalism, which was also resolved. The claim was closed and the client has since increased on-site security supervision. Total losses reported amount to $4,500, with all incidents being successfully managed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Unarmed security patrol services for commercial and residential properties with centralized monitoring.
